args.body: Hi Eve! I just visited your blog at www.eve-blog.com and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you highlight your favorite hobby, hiking — it gives your blog a clear personal focus and makes it feel warm and authentic. A couple of suggestions: you could expand the site with hiking trail reviews, photos from your trips, or gear recommendations to give visitors more to explore. Adding a short "About Me" section and a way to subscribe or contact you would also make it more engaging. Overall, it's a great start — keep it up!

Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some feedback. It's great that you have a personal site, and including your contact email makes it easy for people to reach you. A few suggestions to make it even better: consider adding more content about yourself — like your background, interests, projects, or skills — so visitors can get to know you. You could also include a photo, links to your social profiles, and a bit of visual design to make the site more engaging. Overall, it's a nice, clean start — I'd love to see it grow!
